pool.b.ich_will_spielen_gruss: Coach, have you got a minute?
Coach, I need to talk to you.
pool.b.ich_will_spielen_lage: The doctor wants me out of the squad, but I feel fit enough to play.
The doctor advises a break, and I do not see why.
pool.b.ich_will_spielen_lage.hitzig: The doctor wants to park me in the stands, and I will not put up with it!
Everybody is meddling with my knee, and I am sick of being told I cannot play!
pool.b.ich_will_spielen_lage.loyal: The team needs me, and the break the doctor recommends does not suit me at all.
I do not want to let my teammates down, even if the doctor advises rest.
pool.b.ich_will_spielen_lage.ehrgeizig: If I rest, my rival takes my place, whatever the doctor advises.
I worked too hard for this place to give it up over a recommendation.
pool.b.ich_will_spielen_lage.wechselfreu: At another club they would simply play me with a knock like this.
If I am to sit out over every little thing here, I wonder whether I am in the right place.
pool.b.ich_will_spielen_lage.sensibel: The doctor scares me with his warnings, but I am even more afraid of being forgotten.
I feel guilty when the others fight and I watch because I was told to.
pool.b.fitspritze_warnung_gruss: Coach, one moment please, it is about {name}.
Coach, have you got a moment? I need to say something about {name}.
pool.b.fitspritze_warnung_lage: After the appearance with the jab I have to warn you: the treatment has its price.
The jab got {name} through the match, but the body takes it back later.
pool.b.fitspritze_warnung_lage.hitzig: {name} raged after the match that I had better not refuse him the next jab, and that is exactly what worries me.
{name} demands the jab as if it were a right, and that is dangerous.
pool.b.fitspritze_warnung_lage.loyal: {name} says he plays for the team even with a jab, and that very willingness to sacrifice must not be exploited.
{name} would take jabs for the club until nothing is left, and I have to protect him from that.
pool.b.fitspritze_warnung_lage.ehrgeizig: {name} is desperate to keep his place and is already asking about the next jab, which is a bad sign.
{name} sees the jab as a shortcut to the starting eleven, but a shortcut like that comes with a bill.
pool.b.fitspritze_warnung_lage.wechselfr: {name} plays with a jab to show himself to other clubs, and what happens to his body afterwards means nothing to him.
{name} is thinking about his next contract, not his joints, and I have to say it out loud.
pool.b.fitspritze_warnung_lage.sensibel: {name} seems unsettled after the appearance and asks whether the jab harms him, and I want to answer honestly.
{name} took the jab only reluctantly and is almost ashamed of it, so I want to talk openly with you.
pool.b.arzt_vertrauen_sinkt_gruss: Coach, I am writing to you directly.
Coach, there is something I need to get off my chest.
pool.b.arzt_vertrauen_sinkt_lage: I feel passed over in the latest decisions, because my advice on {name} was not heeded.
I advised against an appearance for {name}, and it took place anyway.
pool.b.arzt_vertrauen_sinkt_lage.hitzig: {name} painted me as a spoilsport in front of everyone, and you let him play anyway!
I will no longer be made a laughing stock when {name} takes the field against my advice!
pool.b.arzt_vertrauen_sinkt_lage.loyal: I have always stood behind the coaching staff, but that {name} played against my advice hurts.
I enjoy working for this club, but my advice on {name} was overruled, and that gnaws at me.
pool.b.arzt_vertrauen_sinkt_lage.ehrgeiz: {name} has noticed that the coach decides over my head, and uses it to his advantage.
If the player gets his way because he is loud enough, my work becomes a formality.
pool.b.arzt_vertrauen_sinkt_lage.wechsel: {name} laughs at my recommendations because he knows he plays anyway, and I wonder what I am there for.
If my advice counts for nothing, I might as well go to a club that takes it seriously.
pool.b.arzt_vertrauen_sinkt_lage.sensibe: I blame myself because {name} played even though I could not convince him, and I feel alone with it.
That {name} played against my advice affects me more than I would like to admit.
